description: This file defines the FeedParser class which parses Atom XML feeds into Entry objects. It handles stream parsing, extracting entries with id, title, link, and publication date.

classes.name: FeedParser
classes.description: A parser for Atom feeds that reads an InputStream and returns a list of Entry objects.

classes.name: FeedParser.Entry
classes.description: Represents a single Atom feed entry with id, title, link, and published date.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse an InputStream containing an Atom feed and return a list of Entry objects.

methods.name: readFeed
methods.description: Reads the <feed> XML element, extracting individual entries.

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Reads an <entry> element, extracting id, title, link, and published date.

methods.name: readTag
methods.description: Reads a specific tag based on its type and returns its content.

methods.name: readBasicTag
methods.description: Reads the text content of a simple XML element.

methods.name: readAlternateLink
methods.description: Handles the <link> tag, extracting the href attribute if rel='alternate'.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Extracts text content from the current element.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips over XML tags that are not of interest.
